title: On Escaping through the yard at dawn
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：escape　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 escape 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the director ① escaped through the yard at dawn in public, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② escapes through the yard at dawn in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ escape through the yard at dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ escaped through the yard at dawn before — a line in the poster for August 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Escaping through the yard at dawn in public, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ escape from the cracked pipe slowly in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Escape from the cracked pipe slowly at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ escapes from the cracked pipe slowly in public every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ escaped through the yard at dawn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To escape through the yard at dawn, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody escapes through the yard at dawn in silence again and somebody must escape through the yard at dawn in public all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 逃走（一般过去式 escaped through the yard at dawn：1979 年导演头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 逃走（一般现在 escapes through the yard at dawn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 逃走（不定式 to escape through the yard at dawn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 逃走（过去完成时 had escaped through the yard at dawn：1973 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 逃走（动名词 escaping through the yard at dawn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 漏出（escape from the cracked pipe slowly：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去漏出从裂了的管子里慢慢漏出）
G. v. 漏出（escape from the cracked pipe slowly：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 逃走（后段两处：新来的演员照例 escapes from the cracked pipe slowly，而母亲又一次 escaped through the yard at dawn）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 escape 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the director escaped through the yard at dawn in public, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director escapes through the yard at dawn in silence whenever the theatre asks.
Escaping through the yard at dawn in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever escape from the cracked pipe slowly in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre escapes from the cracked pipe slowly in public every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother escaped through the yard at dawn again, and the theatre remembered that half.
